about_the_game:
“I killed the demon.”

Would you believe those words?

Reassemble the shattered fragments of time and uncover the hidden truth.
Our Ordinary Home is a narrative puzzle game where you reconstruct a story by arranging fragments of text into the correct order.

One dawn, an unsettling incident strikes what seemed like an ordinary family.

A son covered in blood. A missing mother. And the existence of a “demon” that every family member insists was real.
As you restore the correct sequence of scrambled text and follow the story scene by scene, the truth behind the family’s tragic collapse slowly comes into focus.

Key Features

Fragmented Narrative

  • Rearrange scattered text fragments in chronological order

  • Each chapter reveals new perspectives and buried truths

Multiple Perspectives

  • First-person viewpoint of the protagonist, Juho

  • An objective third-person observer’s perspective

  • Testimonies from detectives, psychiatrists, news reports, and more

Search for the line between truth and madness within these intersecting viewpoints.

Context-Based Puzzles

  • Questions that can only be solved by understanding the story

  • Careful reading and logical reasoning are essential

  • Missed a clue? Go back and reexamine the narrative

Psychological Horror

  • Inspired by Folie à Deux, a real psychiatric phenomenon

  • Collective hysteria spreading within a family

  • Did the “demon” truly exist… or was it something else?

Gameplay

READ – Examine the fragmented pieces of text
ARRANGE – Reorder them according to the flow of time
DISCOVER – The correct arrangement reveals hidden truths
SOLVE – Answer context-based questions to progress to the next chapter

Story

“You don’t understand our family.”

Juho calmly tells the counselor that he killed a demon.

But the police report records only a knife, a hammer, and bathroom tiles soaked in blood.
His mother, Yoon Hwagyeong, vanished from the scene and remains missing.
His younger sister, Sua…

Travel back through time and uncover what truly happened that day.

  • 3:00 AM – Sua eating raw meat in front of the refrigerator

  • 6:20 AM – A ritual to “purify” the dog

  • 6:30 AM – A girl strangling herself

  • And then… what happened inside the bathroom

What was real, and what was a shared delusion?
